visit.title: Your first Sunday, made simple.
visit.text: You do not need to dress a certain way or know anyone. Come as you are — we will look out for you.
visit.pageText: Tell us a little about your visit and we will help you find your way. There is no pressure and no expectation beyond a warm welcome.
visit.step1Body: A member of our welcome team will greet you at the entrance, answer your questions and help you find a seat.
visit.step2Body: Our services include singing, prayer, Scripture reading and a sermon. You are welcome to participate at your own pace.
visit.step3Body: Children’s ministry runs during the Sunday services, with age-appropriate teaching and a safe, supervised space.
visit.step4Body: After the service, join us for refreshments and conversation. No one will pressure you to sign up for anything.
visit.formText: This is optional, but it helps us prepare a warm welcome. We will only use your details to help with your visit.
visit.serviceLabel: Which service would you like to attend?
visit.partyLabel: How many are coming, including you?
visit.consent: I consent to the church using these details to help with my visit.
visit.success: Thank you. We have your visit details and look forward to welcoming you.
visit.faq1A: Come in what you are comfortable wearing. You will find people in everything from smart suits to casual clothes. There is no dress code.
visit.faq2A: Parking arrangements will be confirmed with the church’s address. If you have accessibility needs, tell us in the form and we will help.
visit.faq3A: Sunday services usually last about 90 minutes, including worship and teaching.
visit.faq4Q: Will I be asked for money?
visit.faq4A: There is an opportunity to give during the service, but giving is entirely voluntary. Visitors are never expected to contribute.
visit.faq5A: Yes. Children are welcome in the service and in our children’s ministry. Let us know their ages in the form so we can help.

about.title: Rooted in Christ. Open to our community.
about.text: A church family learning to love God, love one another and serve our neighbourhood.
about.storyBody1: Every church has a story of God’s patience and grace. Ours is still being written — in Sunday worship, in small groups, in quiet prayer and in the everyday faithfulness of ordinary people.
about.storyBody2: Our full history, including our founding and milestones, will be published here once it has been confirmed by church leadership.

about.visionText: To be a worshipping community where every generation encounters Jesus, grows as disciples and serves its neighbours with love.
about.visionNote: Draft statement — awaiting confirmation from church leadership.
about.missionText: To make disciples through worship, teaching, prayer and practical service, and to welcome every person with the hospitality of Christ.
about.missionNote: Draft statement — awaiting confirmation from church leadership.
about.beliefsTitle: The historic faith, held with humility.
about.beliefsText: We affirm the historic Christian creeds. The brief summaries below are general and do not replace the church’s full statement of faith, which will be published once approved by leadership.
about.belief1Body: The Bible is God’s inspired Word and our trustworthy guide for faith and life.
about.belief2Body: We worship one God — Father, Son and Holy Spirit — eternal, holy and full of love.
about.belief3Body: Jesus is fully God and fully human. Through his life, death and resurrection, we are forgiven and reconciled to God.
about.belief4Body: We are saved by grace through faith, not by our own effort, and we respond with grateful obedience.
about.belief5Body: The church is the family of God, called to worship, discipleship, fellowship and service.
about.belief6Body: We live in the hope of Christ’s return, the resurrection of the dead and the renewal of all things.

privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what information this website collects, why we collect it and how it is protected. It reflects the way this website is currently built and should be reviewed by the church before launch.
privacy.collectBody: We collect only the information you choose to give us through our forms: your name, email address, phone number, prayer requests, visit details, messages and newsletter subscription. For abuse prevention we also store a one-way hash of your IP address — never the raw address — alongside form submissions.
privacy.useBody: We use your information to respond to messages, pray with you, prepare for your visit, send the announcements you asked for and keep our church community informed. We do not sell your data and we do not use it for advertising.
privacy.lawfulBody: We process personal data on the basis of your consent and, where applicable, the legitimate interests of the church in responding to enquiries and caring for its community, in line with the Kenya Data Protection Act, 2019.
privacy.accessBody: Prayer requests, visit requests, messages and subscriber details are visible only to authorised church staff and pastoral team members through a password-protected dashboard. Prayer requests are never published without explicit permission.
privacy.retentionBody: We keep information only as long as needed for the purpose it was given. Church staff can archive or delete submissions from the dashboard. Newsletter subscribers can ask to be removed at any time.
privacy.securityBody: Passwords are hashed, administrative access requires authentication, sessions expire, and forms are validated and rate-limited. In production the site should be served over HTTPS. No system is perfectly secure, but we work to protect your information and limit who can access it.
privacy.cookiesBody: This site uses a small cookie to remember your language preference, browser storage to remember your light or dark theme, and a secure session cookie only for staff who sign in. We do not use advertising or analytics tracking cookies.
privacy.thirdBody: No newsletter provider, analytics service or online payment processor is connected at present. If the church adds one, this policy will be updated before it is used. A map embed may load from Google Maps once a church address is configured.
privacy.rightsBody: Under the Data Protection Act, 2019 you may ask to access, correct, delete or restrict the use of your personal data, and you may withdraw consent at any time. To make a request, contact the church using the contact form. You also have the right to complain to the Office of the Data Protection Commissioner in Kenya.
privacy.childrenBody: This website is not directed at children under 18. Please do not submit personal information about a child through our forms without the consent of a parent or guardian.
privacy.changesBody: We may update this policy as the website and church activities develop. The date at the top shows when it was last reviewed.
privacy.contactBody: Questions about privacy can be sent through the contact page. Replace this section with the church’s official data protection contact once one is appointed.
